name: mainline_first_update_covariance_v1
analysis_type: Retrospective exact accounting of the first saved raw update, not a covariance intervention or optimizer experiment.
frozen_protocol: Keep the original role model, source bundle, physical policies, d1000 and all saved observations. Read cached prefix0/1 nodes only; no target filter replay, source fit, new truth or simulation.
decomposition: For each source-conditioned node use K_common=D record.covariance D^T, K_task=D law.task D^T and K_white=law.white I. The first node update has zero f/eta cross covariance, so each point contribution is K_part(x,0)/K_total(0,0) times the saved node mean change at0. Aggregate with saved prefix0 node/identity weights; add the existing node, f-identity and g-identity reweight terms.
validation: Check source identity/order and physical/query mean and covariance against cached nodes; then require component sums to reconstruct every cached node mean update, mixed within-node update and full first update. Failure stops attribution and requires fixing lineage, projection or algebra, not more integration precision.
interpretation: White is persistent point-independent latent discrepancy, not fresh episode noise. Saved mean change already includes the raw noise likelihood; do not add noise again to the denominator. Contributions use the original full denominator and are not predictions after deleting a component.
decision_boundary: Close this diagnostic branch without another representation or risk patch. A future correction requires source-residual support and a single frozen proposal before fresh task evaluation; these two opened target tasks cannot select covariance multipliers.
source_support: Read the previously fixed 51 public-neighbor pairs per source family from stage33 JSON. Summarize squared residual differences minus saved observation variance and the closest pair, including common/task/white predicted contrast variance. Training-data support only; no kernel or covariance multiplier selection.
